name: Detailed claim notification and reviewer mention
requiresDatabases: Rental finance claim sources and permissions

dataIsolation.guard: Rental is the reviewer authority. AM receives only the assigned reviewer identity needed for the source-group notification and does not persist finance records.

definitionOfDone: Initial LINE notification includes complete submitted claim content
Assigned reviewer receives a real LINE mention when a LINE user ID is configured
Long notifications split safely without duplicate retry keys
Review link selects the matching Rental finance claim
A LINE notification failure cannot turn an already-created Rental claim into a failed submission
